$comment: The required-variable inventory, per app, derived from the boot gates in
apps/*/src/env.ts. THIS FILE IS THE PROD ENV PASS CHECKLIST — one source of
truth, read by `pnpm env:verify`, and the thing to update when a gate is
added. It holds NAMES AND REASONS ONLY. No value, secret or otherwise, ever
`always` fires in every environment. `whenLive` fires only when
NEXT_PUBLIC_LAUNCH_MODE is not coming_soon — production runs coming_soon
today, which is why flipping it arms several gates in one deploy.
`recommended` is not gated: absent, the app boots and something is quietly
worse. `forbidden` must NOT be present — see the agent app.

always.name: DATABASE_URL
always.why: Every read path renders an empty state without it, and Gate B demands it on a live boot.

always.name: OTP_LOG_HMAC_KEY
always.why: ≥32 chars. The one gate that fires even in coming_soon, whenever DATABASE_URL is set: the OTP throttle writes destination hashes.

always.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
always.why: Auth and Storage. Its absence makes the funnel inert scaffold, which is why the other gates are conditioned on it.

always.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
always.why: The browser's Supabase client — realtime signals and signed-URL reads.

whenLive.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
whenLive.why: Absent, CAPTCHA is off across the whole funnel and nothing says so.

whenLive.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
whenLive.why: Absent, orphaned GoTrue users are never deleted.

whenLive.name: RESEND_API_KEY
whenLive.why: Absent, the notifier degrades to console — booking confirmations vanish into a log.

whenLive.name: OPS_ALERT_EMAIL
whenLive.why: Absent, every exception alert is skipped with a log line while the deploy looks healthy.

whenLive.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
whenLive.why: Absent, ticket extraction silently swaps to the heuristic reader, which cannot read a photographed ticket at all.

whenLive.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
whenLive.why: Absent, the runtime uses the in-memory FAKE provider: the pay step succeeds and no card is ever charged.

whenLive.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
whenLive.why: Must move in the SAME deploy as the secret. A secret without it is the 'misconfigured' pay step.

whenLive.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
whenLive.why: The endpoint's OWN secret. Absent or stale, every delivery is a signed 400 and no booking reaches paid.

whenLive.name: CRON_SECRET
whenLive.why: Absent, /api/jobs/* refuses while the cron runs: authorizations expire uncaptured and the only symptom is money that never arrives.

whenPush.name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
whenPush.why: All four or none — the console sender REPORTS SUCCESS.

whenPush.name: VAPID_SUBJECT
whenPush.why: mailto: or https:. Apple refuses a push without one.

whenPush.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
whenPush.why: Same value as VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY. Without it the browser can never subscribe.

recommended.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
recommended.why: Absolute links in emails and pushes.

recommended.name: RESEND_FROM
recommended.why: Defaults to Resend's sandbox sender until the domain is verified.

recommended.name: INNGEST_EVENT_KEY
recommended.why: Without it nothing is queued: every event-triggered job is dead.

recommended.name: INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY
recommended.why: apps/web only — it is the app that SERVES /api/inngest.

recommended.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY
recommended.why: Absent, ETAs are haversine and the address step has no autocomplete.

recommended.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN
recommended.why: Absent, errors and ops alerts go to console only.

recommended.name: SENTRY_ORG
recommended.why: Build time. Absent, stack traces stay minified.

recommended.name: SENTRY_PROJECT
recommended.why: Build time. One project per app.

recommended.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
recommended.why: Build time, secret. Absent, source maps are not uploaded.

recommended.name: ASSIGNMENT_HORIZON_HOURS
recommended.why: Must MATCH apps/admin, or the console's badges disagree with the sweep.

always.name: DATABASE_URL
always.why: The console reads everything through core.

always.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
always.why: Gated at boot with NO coming_soon exemption — the console is staff-only and always live.

always.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
always.why: Gated at boot. Staff invites mint GoTrue users.

always.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AGENT_APP_URL
always.why: Gated at boot. The console links operators into the agent app.

recommended.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
recommended.why: NOT gated here, and its absence looks exactly like a wrong password on every sign-in.

recommended.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
recommended.why: Refunds are issued from the console.

always.name: DATABASE_URL
always.why: The task list and the pickup run read through core.

always.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
always.why: Gated at boot with no coming_soon exemption.

recommended.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
recommended.why: NOT gated here, and its absence looks exactly like a wrong password on every sign-in.

forbidden.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
forbidden.why: Deliberately absent from this app's schema: a compromised agent device must not reach a key that bypasses every policy.

forbidden.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
forbidden.why: The agent app never takes a payment. Captures are triggered through core by the pickup flow.
